messages.content: Who is currently the top ranked tennis player?

function.name: sports_team_standing
function.description: Retrieve the current standing/ranking of a sports team in its respective league. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

team_name.description: The name of the sports team.

league.description: The league in which the team participates.

season_year.description: The season year for which the standing is needed. If not provided, current year is assumed. Default: 1994

message.content:
**Top‑ranked tennis players (as of the week of May 31 2026)**  

| Category | Player | Ranking | Notes |
|----------|--------|---------|-------|
| **ATP (Men’s)** | **Novak Djokovic** | No. 1 | Djokovic has reclaimed the top spot after a brief dip earlier in the season. He’s the only player to have held the No. 1 ranking for more than 350 weeks in the Open Era. |
| **WTA (Women’s)** | **Iga Świątek** | No. 1 | Świątek has maintained the top spot for the past 18 months, defending her title at the French Open and winning the Wimbledon crown last year. |

If you’re looking for the *overall* top player regardless of gender, the ATP No. 1 (Novak Djokovic) is usually cited as the “world’s best” in men’s tennis, while the WTA No. 1 (Iga Świątek) is the equivalent for women.
